scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run
scripts.deploy:check:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run
